description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for date strings within the OrangeHRM system. It checks if a given input matches a specified date format using traits for date validation.

classes.name: ApiDate
classes.description: A validation rule class for verifying if an input string is a valid date in the 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the input is a scalar value and a valid date according to the specified format.
